seoTitle: About I Do Art Studios | Nigeria's Number 1 Caricature Haven
seoDescription: I Do Art Studios is Nigeria's number 1 caricature haven, led by celebrity visual artist Owolabi — pioneer of spot-on caricature entertainment in Nigeria and a member of the International Society of Caricature Artists (ISCA).
heading: About I Do Art Studios
bodyParagraphs: I Do Art Studios is led by celebrity visual artist Owolabi, the pioneer of spot-on caricature entertainment in Nigeria. Owolabi is a self-taught artist who studied accounting at Olabisi Onabanjo University before choosing to build a career around art.
He has covered over 300 events across two continents, including the UK, France, Spain, and Lagos, Nigeria, and is a member of the International Society of Caricature Artists (ISCA).
highlights: 300+ events covered across the UK, France, Spain and Nigeria
